title: fix(app-shell): the publish sheet names a batch of hooks or translations in words, not the raw type code (#29902)
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4yKv6mvrKDXRuYdcBwp9hK)_

domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

Fixes #29902

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two new count families in the public `@object-ui/i18n` packs: `preview.changes.typeCount.hook`, `preview.changes.typeCount.translation`.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：Studio 发布面板（待发布变更）的汇总行和分组标题，现在把一批钩子、翻译显示成「3 hooks」「钩子 3」「翻译 2」，不再是原始类型码「3 hook」「hook 3」。
- 为什么改：钩子在对象的 Hooks 标签页、翻译在「全部元数据」表单编辑器里由 Studio 自己创作，作者每次发布都看到未翻译、未变复数的类型码，中文界面里还夹着英文。
- 风险与回滚：只加两行计数文案和 10 个语言包的新键，其他类型和未知类型的显示不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`（`TYPE_COUNT` 末尾两行）、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts`（`typeCount.hook` / `typeCount.translation`）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.groupHeading-13221.test.tsx`，预期全绿，其中含「3 hooks」「钩子 3」「翻译 2」三条新断言。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `TYPE_COUNT` in `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` gains a `hook` and a `translation` row, so the summary line and the per-type group heading read the pack's count family instead of the raw `{{n}} {{type}}` fallback. The fallback stays for types with no row (objectui#13147 note above the table).
- Every one of the ten packs under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/` gains both families, with each CLDR slot its language selects (`es`/`fr`/`pt` `_many`, `ru` `_few`/`_many`, `ar` `_zero`/`_two`/`_few`/`_many`), mirroring the `dataset` rows. zh-CN reads 「钩子 N」 (the platform nav's own word for hooks, `nav_hooks`) and 「翻译 N」.
- One changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, patch.

### Which types get a row: the enumeration

The publish door batches every draft the package holds, whatever its type (`publishPackageDrafts` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` reads `repo.listDrafts({ packageId })`, no type filter). A draft can exist only for a type the registry lets a runtime create or overlay: `allowRuntimeCreate` or `supportsOverlay` true in `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`). Those types, and who in Studio authors them:

| Type | Studio authors it? | Row before |
|---|---|---|
| object, view, page, dashboard, report, app, flow, permission, action, email_template, object_extension, dataset | yes (pillars, object panels, nav, bundle editor) | yes |
| **hook** | yes: `studio-design/ObjectHooksPanel.tsx` saves `hook` drafts | **no, added** |
| **translation** | yes: `studio-design/StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx`, listed in `AREA_FORM_EDITOR_TYPES` (`metadataArea.ts`) | **no, added** |
| seed, mapping, external_catalog, doc, book, position, tool, skill | no Studio editor of its own (only the generic metadata pages) | no, unchanged (raw fallback) |

`picklist`, named on the card, has both flags false: no draft of it can exist, so the publish door never batches one and no row is added. (`agent` keeps its existing row.)

## Acceptance notes

- File surface deviation, agreed with the seat before the edit: the claim named the en and zh-CN packs; all ten packs are touched because `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` requires every pack to define every `en` key (and the per-language plural slots). The `dataset` row set the same precedent.
